The paper addresses both dent and delamination damage types, whereas previous studies only considered dent damage
Average number of impact damages during a 30-year aircraft service life is approximately 5 times based on fleet maintenance records
Impact time follows a uniform distribution due to the random nature of runway debris, hail, and maintenance maloperation
Impact energy is described by a Weibull distribution with parameters varying by threat level (low, medium, high)

Dent depth ranges from 0.024 mm at 5J impact energy to 2.535 mm at 60J impact energy

Detection probability for dent damage at 95% confidence level uses lognormal distribution with μ = -1.785 and σ = 0.677
